definitions: To examine something or someone in order to obtain information.
To pay for items at a shop or supermarket.
To leave a hotel after paying your bill.
To prove to be true or correct upon investigation.
examples: You should check out that new restaurant.
I need to check out at the supermarket.
We checked out of the hotel this morning.
He checked out peacefully in his sleep.
The story checks out, it seems to be true.
